lead: `bun nv proofs --run --show` prints all the standard error of every case, and an attack that logs a large message once per step makes it run for minutes.
body: An exit function that throws a million-letter error again logs it every time, so the output was hundreds of megabytes and the call went over its ten-minute timeout. Leave out `--show` for such a case: pass/fail comes from `--run` alone, and `bun nv try <file> | Select-String <the line you want>` shows the case's own stdout.
